checks_run: Inspected all 41 regular files in CANDIDATE, including learner material, sealed reference code, tests, provenance, validation claims, and production limitations.

Verified file types, searched learner-facing roots for sealed-reference leakage and credential patterns, parsed metadata independently, and hashed the immutable candidate tree before and after review.
Ran the pinned GCC 15.2.0 and Python 3.11.5 environment check and the submitted packaging audit.
Built the starter and sealed reference in a separate writable scratch copy with GCC 15.2.0 and -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror.
Ran the public, sealed reference, and adversarial suites against the reference and the public suite against the intentionally incomplete starter.
Ran 25 additional bounded black-box contract checks covering invocation, parsing, syntax atomicity, statuses, redirections, long pipelines, built-ins, jobs, fg, and process groups.
Ran focused probes for carriage-return tokenization, closed standard descriptors, inherited SIGCHLD disposition, and exit operand validation.
Ran GCC -fanalyzer and repeated all three submitted suites under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer with leak detection disabled.
Reviewed test timeout and cleanup paths, public milestone coverage, progressive-disclosure structure, and license/provenance boundaries.
evidence: The immutable CANDIDATE aggregate SHA-256 was 076abc6af3de93b50a3a95bee319845ba35c2198f401b36aaa2f93638b664383 both before and after review; no candidate file was edited.
Both normal builds succeeded warning-clean. The reference passed 9/9 public, 12/12 sealed, and 4/4 adversarial tests; the disclosed-incomplete starter passed 2/9 and failed 7/9 public tests.
The ASan/UBSan build passed the same 9, 12, and 4 tests with no sanitizer diagnostic. LeakSanitizer independently failed under ptrace as disclosed.
All 25 additional ordinary-environment contract checks passed, including a 41-stage EOF pipeline and verification that pipeline children shared a new process group.

REQUIREMENTS.md permits only unquoted spaces and tabs as separators, but reference lexer line 173 also treats carriage return as whitespace: the argument bytes a\rb produced two arguments and output <a> then <b>, rather than one argument containing carriage return.

Reference child redirection lines 778-794 unconditionally close the descriptor after dup2. With inherited fd 0 or fd 1 closed, open returns the target descriptor, dup2 is a no-op, and close invalidates it; input and output probes returned 1 with EBADF.

When the shell inherited SIGCHLD=SIG_IGN, a child exiting 7 was automatically reaped and the reference returned 0. Initialization does not normalize SIGCHLD and the ECHILD path returns an uninitialized stored status.

The sealed PTY test uses blocking waitpid(child, 0) after its read deadline and kills only the shell PID on failure, contrary to the repository guidance requiring bounded tests and process-group cleanup.

Project, source, and commit identities agree across the manifest and provenance document, and labels remain conservatively GENERATED plus PARTIAL with independent validation required and productionized false.

The manifest value named provenance_sha256 equals the self-declared snapshot_sha256 but not the SHA-256 of PROVENANCE.json, which is 8aa702b8b64241bda70f3a63e3d1b9a681e7dc87f4d5930b9b4f764f584e5dad; the submitted audit checks equality of fields, not a tamper-evident document digest.

Learner-facing roots contained no sealed implementation or answer-key paths, and the only discovered URL was the declared upstream provenance link. The public suite nevertheless has no positive background, fg, or PTY job-control case.
limitations: LeakSanitizer could not run under the ptrace-based harness; ASan and UBSan ran with detect_leaks=0.

The immutable upstream catalog snapshot, source Git object database, and external tutorial were not present and network access was not used, so source hashes, CC0 evidence, and the no-copy assertion could not be independently recomputed.
Only static directory separation could be checked here; enforcement of the actual learner view is controlled by the external factory.
No benchmark, coverage-guided fuzzing, portability matrix, or production-readiness check was performed; the candidate explicitly makes none of those claims.
The inherited-signal and closed-standard-descriptor probes exercise uncommon but contractually unexcluded launch environments.
